author: PlaysByBrulesRules
body:
I didn’t pay much attention to adornments until I had reached T10, when you reach the end game, adornments and amities start to become an extremely important part of specialized builds. 

While leveling my advice would be to prioritize 2% ward gems into the gear you’re using and probably avoid master forging anything unless you get a good fey yeti coat or something really special
